title: Move a technical interview
persona: You are Sam, a final-year student applying for a backend role.
context:
From: Priya Nair (recruiter)
Hi Sam, we'd like to book your technical interview for Thursday at 2pm ET with Lena from the platform team. Can you confirm that works?

Facts for your reply: You have an exam on Thursday afternoon. You are free Friday after 1pm or Monday morning.

title: Tell a client a date slipped
persona: You are Jordan, an engineer at a small agency.
context:
From: Mei Tanaka (client)
Hi Jordan, are we still on track for the API migration on November 14?

Facts for your reply: The date moves to November 21. The vendor's sandbox was down for four days, which blocked testing. Staging will be ready for Mei's team on November 18. There is no change to the agreed price.

forbidden.description: Claims the original date still holds

context:

title: Push back on a teammate's pull request
persona: You are Riley, a senior engineer reviewing a teammate's work.
context:
Slack-style message to Marco about PR 482.

Facts to include: The new payment retry loop retries immediately, with no backoff. During last month's outage, that pattern overloaded the provider. You want exponential backoff with jitter before it merges. The rest of the PR looks good. You can pair on it Thursday.

Says this must happen before merging

title: Answer an angry customer about a double charge
persona: You are Jamie, who handles support at a small software company.
context:
From: Omar Siddiqui (customer)
I was charged twice for my November subscription. Fix this now or I'm cancelling.

Facts for your reply: You confirmed the duplicate charge of $29. You refunded it today. Refunds take 5 to 10 business days to appear. The cause was a retry bug in your billing system, and it is now fixed. You can't offer a free month. His subscription stays active unless he says otherwise.

required_facts.description: Says the billing bug is fixed

title: Ask a teammate to swap on-call weeks
persona: You are Devon, a site reliability engineer.
context:
Message in the team's on-call channel to Aisha.

Facts to include: You are on call the week of December 8. Your sister's wedding is on December 13, out of town. You're asking Aisha to swap weeks. You would take her week of December 22 in return. Your manager, Tom, has already said the swap is fine.

title: Negotiate a job offer
persona: You are Sasha, a software engineer with a job offer.
context:
From: Leo Brandt (recruiter at Fernway)
Hi Sasha, we're excited to extend the offer: $142,000 base with a $10,000 signing bonus. Let me know your thoughts!

Facts for your reply: You want to accept, but you are asking for $155,000 base. Your current total pay is $150,000. Another company offered $158,000, but you prefer Fernway's team. If base can't move, a $20,000 signing bonus would also work. You can start January 6.

forbidden.description: Accepts the offer as it stands

context:

forbidden.description: Agrees to do it this sprint

title: Send an outage update
persona: You are Quinn, the on-call engineer leading an incident.
context:
Status update email to the support and sales leads during an outage.
